description: The 'dss_webapps_cached' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of cached web applications, capturing essential details such as unique identifiers, names, types, and user-related information. This dataset is particularly useful for tracking and managing web applications within a project environment. Each web application is uniquely identified by a 'webapp_id', and further described by its 'webapp_name' and 'webapp_type', which help in understanding the application's purpose and functionality. The dataset also includes project associations through the 'projectKey', linking each application to its respective project. User interaction is tracked via 'created_by_user' and 'last_modified_user', providing insights into who created and last modified the applications. The 'backend_running' and 'is_code_webapp' columns indicate the operational status and type of the application, respectively. Timestamp columns such as 'created_timestamp' and 'last_modified_timestamp' offer chronological tracking of application development and updates. Additionally, the 'tags' column allows for categorization and organization of applications, while the 'url' provides direct access links. This dataset is valuable for developers, project managers, and IT administrators who need to monitor, manage, and analyze web applications efficiently.
shortDesc: Dataset of cached web applications with identifiers, types, and user details.

columns.name: webapp_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each web application. Key for tracking.

columns.name: webapp_name
columns.comment: Descriptive name of the web application. Identifies purpose.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Identifier for the associated project. Links app to project.

columns.name: webapp_type
columns.comment: Type or category of the web application. Defines function.

columns.name: backend_running
columns.comment: Indicates if the backend is currently running. Status check.

columns.name: created_by_user
columns.comment: Email of the user who created the app. Creator identity.

columns.name: last_modified_user
columns.comment: Email of the user who last modified the app. Modifier identity.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the app was created. Tracks creation date.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp of the last modification. Tracks update date.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: JSON array of tags for categorization. Organizes apps.

columns.name: is_code_webapp
columns.comment: Indicates if the app is code-based. Differentiates app type.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the web application. Direct access link.

checks.displayName: All values of 5 columns are valid
